pages.title: Ministry of Culture and National Heritage - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt: The**Ministry of Culture and National Heritage**([Polish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polish_language):*Ministerstwo Kultury i Dziedzictwa Narodowego*) is a[ministry within Polish government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministries_of_Poland). It is responsible for national heritage preservation and[Polish culture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Culture_of_Poland)promotion. Ministry oversees state or partially state[cultural institutions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cultural_institution)and implements the[law regarding art](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Art_and_culture_law)and[cultural property](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cultural_property_law). The ministry headquarters is located at[Potocki Palace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Potocki_Palace,_Warsaw), 15[Krakowskie Przedmieście Street](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krakowskie_Przedmie%C5%9Bcie)in[Warsaw](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warsaw).[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Culture_and_National_Heritage#cite_no
